name_input: PERFECT COLOURANTS AND PLASTICS PRIVATE LTD
product_summary: Manufacturer of plastic masterbatches and compounds (brand PCPPL). Product lines from own website (perfectcolourants.com): Colour Masterbatch (4500+ Pantone/RAL shades, carriers PE, PP, LDPE, LLDPE, EVA, PS, HIPS, GPPS, ABS, SAN, PA6/Nylon, PC, POM, PBT, PET, TPU, PLA, PVC); White Masterbatch based on 30-70% rutile-grade titanium dioxide (grades WH-3421 70% TiO2, WH-3427 60%, WH-8443 50%, WH-8430 40%, WH-8438 31%, HIPS WH-1502/WH-1419); Black Masterbatch; Special Effect (metallic/pearlescent); Transparent; Universal; PET; PVC; Liquid; Biodegradable/Compostable; Conductive; Flame Retardant; Laser Marking (black/white); plus a long list of additive masterbatches (UV, antioxidant, slip, antiblock, antistatic/permanent antistatic, anti-fog, anti-rodent, desiccant, blowing/foaming agent, anti-warpage, anti-scratch, antibacterial, impact modifier, nucleating, optical brightener, chain extender for PET, cooling, flow enhancer, anti-algae, abrasion resistance, fragrance, anti-ripening). Compounds: Long Glass Filled Compound (LFT, PP/PA/PPS/PBT/SAN/ABS matrix, 20-40% glass), Short Glass Filled Compound, Purging Compounds, Light Diffuser Compound, Night Glow Compound. Applications listed: agriculture, automotive, FMCG, pharmaceutical, construction & chemicals, electronics, flexible packaging, luggage, toys, defence.
comment: Declared HS 320649 ('other colouring matter, n.e.s.') is CORRECT for the core colour/special-effect masterbatch line and is retained — no HS-based rejection. However the declaration is materially incomplete: (1) White Masterbatch is explicitly TiO2-based (30-70% rutile TiO2 per own technical tables) and belongs in 3206.11 (pigments/p preparations based on titanium dioxide, >=80% TiO2) or 3206.19 for lower-loaded grades — 3206.49 is not the right subheading for the dominant white line; (2) Black Masterbatch (carbon black) maps to 3206.49 only if carbon-black-based preparations, otherwise 2803.00 for pure carbon black — cannot be split without a customs line; (3) the large additive-masterbatch family (UV, antioxidant, slip, antiblock, antistatic, flame retardant, nucleating, optical brightener, impact modifier, chain extender, desiccant, blowing agent) is not 'colouring matter' at all and would fall under 3812.30 (compound stabilisers/antioxidant preparations) or 3824.99 (chemical preparations n.e.s.) — these lines are missing from the declaration; (4) glass-filled compounds (LFT/SFT, PP/ABS/PA/PBT/PPS with 20-40% glass fibre) are reinforced polymer compounds, i.e. primary-form plastics in Ch.39 (e.g. 3902.10 PP, 3903.30 ABS, 3907.40/3907.99 polycarbonate/polyester, 3908.90 polyamide) — a completely different chapter, absent from the declaration; (5) purging compounds, light diffuser and night-glow compounds are further Ch.38/3206 lines. Industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' is a loose fit: the company is a plastics-additives/polymer-compounding converter (petrochemical downstream), not an oil & gas or bulk petrochemical producer — industry classification should be read as 'chemicals/plastics additives'. Trader signs: none found — the site presents own manufacturing (in-house colourists, spectrophotometers, 37+ years, own grade codes such as WH-3421), so role = manufacturer; no evidence of pure resale. All product claims above are from the company's own website only and are therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no customs line, B/L or shipment record was checked in this task (out of scope), so no HS code here is corroborated by an actual export declaration. Export to '100+ countries' is a website claim, not verified. No CIN/PAN/GST data researched per scope; left null.
